## Changes

- Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant automated tests passed; include commands and counts.
- [ ] Production build passed.
- [ ] Relevant manual QA performed; record expected and actual results.
- [ ] Coverage scope and results linked when applicable.
- [ ] Security impact assessed; link findings or explain no change.

Evidence: link reports, screenshots/traces, tested commit, and known failures.

Peer review: teammate review/approval is required separately; author QA is not approval.
